description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the AWS IoT Data Plane service, including methods for managing thing shadows and messages.

classes.name: IotDataPlaneClient
classes.description: A client class to communicate with AWS IoT Data Plane API, providing methods for device shadow management, message publication, and retrieval.

methods.name: deleteThingShadow
methods.description: Deletes the shadow document of a specified IoT device (thing).

methods.name: deleteThingShadowAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the shadow document of a specified IoT device.

methods.name: getRetainedMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a retained message for a specific topic in AWS IoT.

methods.name: getRetainedMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version for retrieving a retained message.

methods.name: getThingShadow
methods.description: Retrieves the shadow document of a specific IoT device.

methods.name: getThingShadowAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version for retrieving a device's shadow.

methods.name: listNamedShadowsForThing
methods.description: Lists all named shadows associated with a specified IoT device.

methods.name: listNamedShadowsForThingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous listing of shadow names for a device.

methods.name: listRetainedMessages
methods.description: Lists all retained messages stored in AWS IoT.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to a specified MQTT topic.

methods.name: updateThingShadow
methods.description: Updates the shadow document for a specified IoT device.
